## Eventide v1.1.1

The big look update: a new mod menu, a new main menu, a new launcher and a new HUD. (v1.1.0 went out without these changes; this is the release that has them.)

### New
- **Mod menu redesign** (Right Shift): bigger and easier to read. A rail on the left for Mods, Cosmetics, Client and Profiles, with Floating and Edit HUD at the bottom. Pills along the top for All and each category. Cards show each mod's icon, name and a line about it, with a dot that lights up when it's on. Hover a card for its settings gear, and the header shows the full description of the mod under your mouse.
- **Smoother menu motion**: the menu springs open over a frosted-glass background, highlights glide between sections and pills, cards lift when you hover them, and switching a mod pops its dot with a ripple.
- **Main Menu**: a new title screen with a greeting, a big Eventide wordmark, Singleplayer, Multiplayer and Realms buttons that grow and glow on hover, and a Continue card that jumps straight back into the world or server you last played on. Turn the Main Menu mod off to get Minecraft's own back.
- **HUD bar**: your name, FPS, server and clock in one glass bar at the top of the screen, with your coordinates above it. A new Player Name pill shows your head and name.
- **Music Player styles**: Glass (the new default) and Compact, both with the line being sung in a bar underneath. Classic is still there.
- **Floating menu you can walk around**: it hangs in the world where you opened it, so you can keep moving and look around it. Your crosshair is the pointer, walking never types into the search, and R brings it back in front of you.

### Changed
- **Launcher**: a new dark look with an icon rail on the left and a "Ready to launch" home with your version, in-game name, mods, memory and a big Launch game button. Launching shows a full-window progress screen with Cancel. Instance pages match the new look, and you still add mods from Modrinth on an instance's page.
- HUD pills are see-through glass tinted with your theme colour.
- The Glow Cone hat is now a wide, flat cone of soft glowing light.

### Fixed
- Small HUD and menu text is sharp at every size instead of jagged.
- The main menu sits in the middle of the screen when there's nothing to continue yet.
